summary: Opened the Sales Order list (Selling → Sales Order, list view at http://127.0.0.1:8100/app/sales-order) and read the rows without modifying anything. Exactly 3 Sales Orders exist and all three carry customer names beginning with "Seed:": "Seed: Alpha Traders" (SAL-ORD-2026-00001), "Seed: Beacon Supplies" (SAL-ORD-2026-00002) and "Seed: Cobalt Retail" (SAL-ORD-2026-00003). The set was verified two ways: (a) with all filters cleared the unfiltered list contains only these 3 records (page size 20, so nothing is paginated away), and (b) the Customer Name standard filter set to "Seed:" (customer_name like %Seed:%) returns exactly the same 3 rows.
